children: Shares of Hagerty fell after it said a stockholder would sell 8.25 million shares in a secondary public offering.
The stock was down 7.4%, to $12.28, after hours after closing 0.9% lower, at $13.26. At the close, the stock was down 1.3% this year.

The company said the shares in the offering would be sold by Hagerty Holding Corp., and that it wouldn't receive any of the proceeds. HHC plans to use the proceeds to effect a redemption of a corresponding number of its shares for the benefit of the Kim Hagerty Revocable Trust, the company said.
The underwriters for the offering are expected to have a 30-day option to buy up to an additional roughly 1.24 million shares.
